22:t_000:2.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「They mean to cause confusion and use the opportunity to let the residents escape!」

22:t_000:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Deploy the security forces! Eliminate this city's residents as potential rebels!」

22:t_001:0.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Those bat bastards are coming out!」

22:t_001:1.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「What do we do!? Our equipment can't fight mobile weapons!」

22:t_001:2.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Don't worry. Focus on guiding the civilians to safety.」

22:t_001:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ reports that the $$新地球皇国$$ is withdrawing its infantry and leaving the rest to its mobile weapons.」

22:t_001:5.en:
$n
「They mean to slaughter everyone in town...!」

22:t_002:0.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「W-what!? Where did that machine come from!?」

22:t_002:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「I was told this planet's control of $$次元力$$ was primitive...!」

22:t_002:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! All of the $$ジェニオン$$'s systems are working properly.」

22:t_002:3.en:
$n
「$$ＡＧ$$'s doing a great job, even without enough supplies...」

22:t_002:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The enemy unmanned units have identified us as their target and are closing in.」

22:t_002:5.en:
$n
「Tell Major $$カリーニン$$ we're counting on him to evacuate the residents while we deal with the $$デイモーン$$s.」

22:t_002:7.en:
$n
「We still have more to do after this...! I'll take them down as quickly as I can!」

22:t_003:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't let your guard down, $n...! Reinforcements are coming!」

22:t_005:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's all right. Our forces have arrived, too.」

22:t_006:1.en:
$n
「You can see for yourself. No need to worry.」

22:t_006:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Good work, $l. Rejoin the main force.」

22:t_006:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Nobody can match him at infiltrating enemy territory and creating confusion.」

22:t_006:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We were able to approach the city while $n kept the enemy's attention.」

22:t_006:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$, who was commanding the local Resistance, reports that the residents' evacuation is complete.」

22:t_006:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll handle the Empire! Resistance forces, escort the residents!」

22:t_006:8.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Roger! Thanks for your help!」

22:t_006:9.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「We're counting on you, $c!」

22:t_006:10.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Leave the townspeople to us!」

22:t_008:0.en:
$n
「Is to get rid of those puppets.」

22:t_008:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「Good work, $n. $$ボロット$$ and I will back you up.」

22:t_008:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Aw, cut it out. I'm doing it all for Miss $$スズネ$$!」

22:t_009:0.en:
$n
「That bastard... He'll pay for that once the battle's over.」

22:t_009:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then let's make sure we win, $n.」

22:t_009:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the enemy is operating Earth-built weapons automatically.」

22:t_009:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's $$サイデリアル$$'s usual tactic.」

22:t_009:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, stay alert. They may send reinforcements once they see our strength.」

22:t_009:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, destroy the enemy forces quickly, then leave this area.」

22:t_009:7.en:
$n
(I'll show you, $$サイデリアル$$...! There are plenty of people on this Earth who will never bow to you...!)

22:t_010:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Have we finished them off?」

22:t_010:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's about all there is to it!」

22:t_010:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Don't speak too soon! Something else is coming!」

22:t_011:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That $$サイデリアル$$ ship is transmitting to all our units.」

22:t_011:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「My name is $$ダバラーン・タウ$$. I am a general and Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$'s right-hand man.」

22:t_012:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ストラウス$$... The commander of the entire $$新地球皇国$$ military.」

22:t_012:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「One of his closest aides? That's quite a big shot...!」

22:t_012:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「Is he planning to crush us here...!?」

22:t_012:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...$c. I've seen how you fight.」

22:t_012:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But ultimately, your resistance is futile. You cannot defeat us... or Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

22:t_012:7.en:
$n
「You came all this way to provoke us?」

22:t_012:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then come feel our power for yourself!」

22:t_012:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「General $$ダバラーン$$... It is true that challenging you with our current strength would mean a pointless death.」

22:t_012:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But remember this. We will defeat you and liberate this planet...!」

22:t_012:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, pull back! Our objective is complete. There's no reason to linger!」

22:t_013:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I hope you'll provide that esteemed person with a little entertainment.」

22:t_100:0.en:
$n
「Don't think you can beat us with machines built for keeping public order...!」

22:t_100:1.en:
$n
「I won't let you hurt a single person in this town!」

22:t_101:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
「The Empire is abducting civilians... What on earth is it doing with them...?」

22:t_101:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
(Hang on, $$ランカ$$...! I will find you, no matter what!)

22:t_102:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I've finished checking the data Major $$カリーニン$$ sent us.」
